item.title: Nous Research Extends Free Access to Tencent Hy3 Model Through August 18
item.summary: Nous Research has extended free access to Tencent Hunyuan's Hy3 model on its Nous Portal through August 18, citing continued demand for the model it describes as optimized for cost-effective agentic use with strengths in coding, tool-calling, reasoning, and long-context tasks.
